intents.description: Open the notes or notepad application.
Type the dictated text into the app that is currently in focus.
Open YouTube without playing anything in particular.
Search for and play a specific video, channel or topic on YouTube.
Open Spotify without playing anything in particular.
Play the user's own liked or saved songs collection on Spotify.
Play a specific song, artist, album or playlist on Spotify.
Pause or stop whatever is currently playing.
Resume or continue playback that was paused.
Skip to the next track or video.
Make the sound louder by increasing the volume.
Make the sound quieter by decreasing the volume.
Open the web browser without searching for anything.
Search the web or look something up online for the user.
Close the current window or a named application.
Out of scope: chit-chat, a question, or a request for something the assistant cannot do.
